items.text: No one is on screen except: Archie.
Exactly four men are present: Archie, the knife man in a black puffer, the man in a green hoodie, and the older man in a long coat. There are no other people.
The three buyers (puffer, green hoodie, long coat) look the same as in the S3 image: same clothes, builds and hair.
Archie matches the Archie biz sprite master in outfit and build.
Archie is the closest figure to the camera, centre-right, with his back three-quarters turned to the camera.
Archie's weight is on his front foot, as if he has just stepped into the gap.
The knife man is a few steps beyond Archie, centre-left, coming toward the camera.
The man in the green hoodie is one step behind the knife man.
The older man in the long coat stands back by the car, hands in pockets, still.
The knife man holds a yellow Stanley knife out in front of him, with the blade extended a short way.
Archie holds a carrier bag in one hand.
Archie is large in the foreground and sits between the camera and the knife man, so he visibly blocks the knife's path to the viewer.
The yard and car match the blank plate, with nothing else in the room added or changed.
Archie holds nothing in his hands except the carrier bag: no weapon, tool or other object in either hand.
No legible text or logos anywhere in the image.
No player face is shown (the player is never seen).
Nothing story-critical sits in the bottom ~10% of the image.
The focal point survives the small-phone crop.
